a: i18n prepares software for locales; l10n adapts to a specific locale.
Store translatable strings in locale files, not hard-coded UI.
Languages have different plural categories; use ICU message format.
Right-to-left languages need mirrored layouts and logical CSS.
Format numbers/dates with Intl APIs per locale.
Fake translations reveal truncation and hard-coded strings.
Provide screenshots/context so translators choose correct wording.
Avoid stitching sentences; word order varies by language.
Detect from Accept-Language, user profile, or explicit picker.
Use locale-aware currency formatters; store amounts as integers/decimals carefully.
